capabilities: evaluate LaTeX expressions inline via trigger suffixes (=, \approx, @diff, @solve)
plot interactive 2D and 3D graphs, vector fields, contours, and ODE phase portraits
perform symbolic CAS operations including derivatives, integrals, and factoring
expand LaTeX Suite snippets with tabstops, conceal, and bracket coloring in notes and Excalidraw
snapshot and restore Excalidraw drawing element positions and sizes
extras: Advanced CAS features (@limit, @taylor, @partfrac, @expand, @steps) need a separate ~19 MB Giac WASM file manually downloaded into the plugin folder; Excalidraw OD features are inert without the Excalidraw plugin.
intentEvidence: It also extends into Excalidraw: canvas text auto-renders into equation images
problem: Obsidian renders LaTeX but cannot evaluate expressions, solve equations, or plot graphs, and LaTeX snippet tools do not work inside Excalidraw canvases.

relations.evidence: Excalidraw OD features require the Excalidraw community plugin to also be installed and enabled
The full LaTeX Suite snippet-expansion engine is vendored directly into the editor — no separate plugin required

summary: Engineering math plugin that evaluates LaTeX inline, plots 2D/3D graphs, runs CAS operations, and adds LaTeX snippets to notes and Excalidraw.
